title: Hydraulic Power — Green System Engine Driven Pump — Interim Shaft Seal Kit Installation
abstract: Installation of a two-element shaft seal kit on the green system engine driven pump, replacing the original shaft seal with a pressure-balanced primary seal and a scavenge lip that returns leakage to the case drain instead of to the drive pad.

sections.planning_reason: Hydraulic fluid was being found in the accessory gearbox drive pad cavity at 1.4 events per 1000 flight hours against a fleet target of 0.2, caused by the green system engine driven pump shaft seal leaking under the pressure spikes generated when the landing gear and the flaps are operated together. The loss was gradual and produced no warning before the reservoir reached the refill line, so the first indication was usually a wet drive pad found at a transit check.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin installs a two-element shaft seal kit consisting of a pressure-balanced primary seal and a scavenge lip seal that returns leakage to the case drain rather than to the drive pad. The kit is fitted with the pump on the aircraft and the case drain line is flushed before return to service.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the fan cowl and get access to the pump from zone 123. Depressurise the green system and drain the pump case. Remove the pump solenoid BE759984-33 and the shaft seal assembly. Install the two-element kit and torque the retaining nuts AES818405K5. Flush the case drain line and refill the system. Re-install the solenoid, re-secure the clamp of FIN 280GG8 and do the pump operational test. Record the kit installation against the pump serial number and start the repeat drive pad cavity check at 1200 flight hours.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to ZEPHYR-20, ZEPHYR-22 and ZEPHYR-24 classic aircraft whose green system engine driven pump is at the original shaft seal standard. Both pump positions are normally done in the same visit. Aircraft already at the kit standard are not affected.
sections.material_note: Kit K2910-1051-01 contains the two seal elements, the retaining nuts and the consumables for one pump. Lead time is ten weeks from order. The removed seal assembly is scrapped locally once the embodiment is recorded.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next engine driven pump removal, or within 36 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.

issue.reason: The bulletin is cancelled and the material note now states that the kit is withdrawn from the catalogue and no longer supplied.

abstract: Cancelled interim bulletin that installed a two-element shaft seal kit on the green system engine driven pump. It was withdrawn once the redesigned pump case became available, and is retained for record only.

sections.accomplishment_summary: This bulletin is cancelled and must not be embodied. For the record, the accomplishment was as follows. Open the fan cowl and get access to the pump from zone 123. Depressurise the green system and drain the pump case. Remove the pump solenoid BE759984-33 and the shaft seal assembly. Install the two-element kit and torque the retaining nuts AES818405K5. Flush the case drain line and refill the system. Re-install the solenoid, re-secure the clamp of FIN 280GG8 and do the pump operational test. Operators who have embodied this bulletin keep the repeat drive pad cavity check every 1200 flight hours until they embody the replacement bulletin.
sections.effectivity_note: Cancelled with effect from July 2026 and replaced by the case drain architecture bulletin. Aircraft that carry the interim kit remain airworthy and are covered by the replacement bulletin, which supersedes both the kit and the repeat cavity check. No new embodiment of this bulletin is permitted.
sections.material_note: Kit K2910-1051-01 is withdrawn from the catalogue and no further kits are produced or supplied. Residual kit stock held by operators may be used to support an existing installation until the replacement bulletin is embodied, after which it is scrapped. Because conversion is by attrition, a kit ordered against this bulletin could otherwise have been raised for a pump that had already been exchanged; the catalogue entry is closed for that reason.

type_data.compliance_time: Cancelled. No compliance time applies; the replacement bulletin carries the current requirement.
